exposure: Maternal HDP with well-controlled blood pressure
Maternal HDP with poorly controlled blood pressure
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 3117 offspring from pregnant women recruited in the Jiangsu Birth Cohort study in China.
finding: Maternal hypertensive disorder in pregnancy was associated with an 82% increased risk of overall strabismus, an 82% increased risk of exophoria, and a 136% increased risk of intermittent exotropia in offspring at 3 years of age.
